label: VERIFIED
extraction: Santa Method reviewer prompt structure and rubric. Reviewer prompt: 'You are an independent quality reviewer. You have NOT seen any other review of this output. Task Specification: {task_spec}. Output Under Review: {output}. Evaluation Rubric: {rubric}. Evaluate each criterion: PASS (criterion fully met) or FAIL (specific issue found, cite exact problem). Return structured JSON: {verdict: "PASS|FAIL", checks: [{criterion, result, detail}], critical_issues: [...], suggestions: [...]} Be rigorous. Your job is to find problems, not to approve.' Two reviewers (B and C) run concurrently with context isolation, identical rubric, same inputs. Verdict gate: both must PASS for NICE; otherwise NAUGHTY with merged issues deduplicated. Fix cycle: fix all critical issues, re-run both reviewers with fresh agents (no memory carryover), max 3 iterations then escalate.
